1 | /**
2 |  * Structural HTML Export
3 |  *
4 |  * Produces a portable offline HTML snapshot of the structural map.
5 |  *
6 |  * Architecture note (PRD §9):
7 |  *   The full Archify CLI pipeline (validate → deliver → visual-check) runs
8 |  *   server-side as a bounded subprocess.  This client-side module provides:
9 |  *     1. A lightweight fallback export when the server-side Archify
10 |  *        renderer is not yet configured (structural HTML only).
11 |  *     2. The data preparation that feeds the server-side compiler.
12 |  *
13 |  * The fallback export:
14 |  *   - Uses only trusted templates with escaped data
15 |  *   - Never executes repository code
16 |  *   - Embeds manifest/provenance information
17 |  *   - Clearly labels deferred capabilities
18 |  *   - Works offline with no external requests
19 |  *
20 |  * INTEGRATION_SLOT: proposals.detail
21 |  * When the Archify server-side renderer is connected, replace
22 |  * triggerFallbackExport() with a call to the export endpoint and
23 |  * download the validated artifact.
24 |  */
25 | 
26 | import type { FilePage, Graph, Snapshot } from '../../types/v1'
27 | 
28 | export interface ExportManifest {
29 |   schema_version: '1.0'
30 |   export_type: 'structural_map'
31 |   snapshot_id: string
32 |   project_id: string
33 |   source_kind: string
34 |   source_ref?: string
35 |   exported_at: string
